exposure: maternal hemodynamics (Total Peripheral Resistance, Cardiac Output)
cohort: 49 Latin American patients admitted to a single center with severe early-onset pre-eclampsia.
finding: The study identified two distinct subphenotypes of severe early-onset pre-eclampsia; Subphenotype 2, characterized by specific hemodynamic and biomarker profiles, was associated with worse maternal outcomes and appeared less modifiable after in-hospital treatment.
